entities.summary: Jérémy Roy is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman. He is currently playing with HC CSKA Moscow in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Roy was drafted with the 31st overall pick by the Sharks in the second round of the 2015 NHL Entry Draft.
